case.title: Where is my booking page link
case.text: Hi where can I find the link to my booking page? I want to put it on my Instagram
case.why: Short, common how-to; ideal candidate for a ready-to-approve reply.

output.reply:
Hi Ayesha! You can find your booking page link in Settings → Booking Page → Share. Copy the link from there and paste it into your Instagram bio. Your page address also appears under Page link in the same Settings → Booking Page area, and it looks like book.slotwise.test/your-business. Please make sure Publish booking page is turned on so clients can use the link. One tip: if you ever change your page address, old links stop working, so you'd need to update your Instagram bio. Let us know if you need anything else!

Slotwise Support
